name: parabolic_sar_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, Parabolic SAR flips (from above to below price) mark the moment where directional order-flow imbalance shifts. At 5-second resolution, a SAR flip confirmed by ADX(36) > 20 (3-min trend filter) and price above session VWAP signals that VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms have pivoted to net-buy mode — their execution algorithms are now absorbing sell-side resting orders. The anti-whipsaw filter (fewer than 4 SAR flips in the prior 3 minutes) screens out the range-bound sessions where SAR oscillates uselessly; in genuine trending NIFTY conditions, the confirmed flip initiates a 10-20 spot-point continuation wave over the next 30-90 seconds as the institutional order continues to execute.
core_signal_oneliner: Parabolic SAR direction flip confirmed by 3-min ADX trending filter, VWAP alignment, and anti-whipsaw check (fewer than 4 flips in prior 3 min)
